entries.surface: .grok-plugin/ + scripts/generate-grok-plugin-index.py + version_sync + packaging tests + README + agent frontmatter
entries.migration_impact: Downstream repos using the plate marketplace for Grok will now see plate-core with agent + MCP previews in the Marketplace tab (Ctrl+L). Existing Copilot flow and pip install plate-core are unchanged. After this ships, Grok users should `grok plugin update` (or re-add the marketplace source) + reload (r in Plugins) or restart TUI to pick up the new catalog + updated agent guidance.
entries.agent_notes: This was a packaging + discovery gap between the Copilot-only .github/plugin/ surface and Grok's .grok-plugin/ + plugin-index.json requirement. The vendored generator + dual marketplace manifests + version sync now keep both in lockstep. plate.agent.md frontmatter extended with prompt_mode/permission_mode/agents_md for full Grok menu integration. #570 is the driver; the CLI-agnostic work (Epic #202) is now complete for Grok TUI.
migration_guidance: 1. `grok plugin marketplace add akasper/plate` (or re-add if already configured under a 'plate' source) now lists plate-core with rich component summaries (1 agent, 1 MCP).
2. `grok plugin install plate-core@plate-marketplace --trust` (or via TUI i/d) + enable in config.
3. Use `grok inspect`, Plugins tab (Ctrl+L), or `/agent plate` (or host picker) to confirm the plate persona and plate-core MCP tools are active.
4. `grok plugin validate .plugin` (or installed copy) continues to pass.
5. For local dev: the generator can be run with `python3 scripts/generate-grok-plugin-index.py` after editing agents/ or .mcp.json inside the payload.
